decision.summary: A transient multi-axis negative offset is evident from index 515 to 524, strongest in N and E, with incomplete recovery and no confirmed return within the allowed context. The U component shows a delayed, smaller dip. Due to ambiguous return and lack of opposing motion before 560, status is uncertain. No other temporary offsets are supported in [480,560].

intervals.observation: Multi-axis negative excursion (N, E ≈ −6 MAD, U shallower/delayed) beginning ~515, sustained through 520–523, with only partial recovery by 524; no clear opposing return observed within allowed context [480,560].
